items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution. Existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failed-work repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work should continue without new production requests, requeues, experiments, duplicate telemetry, spend, or monetization expansion. Current evidence supports 39 configured analytics sites, 103 SEO actions, 27 deployed improvements awaiting measurement, 7 failed requests, and only 1 proven outcome; revenue is limited to $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 with $0 site-attributed commission. No new site proposal is warranted this cycle; revisit the highest-value reversible opportunity after queue capacity and measurement evidence improve.
